'''The Palace of Light''' was an entertainment pavilion located in the [[Lola Curich Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. It boasted over six hundred games, including [[Starfight]], [[zero gravity team wars]], and various [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] machines.
